The '''Crystal Wasters''' were a group of surfers that were based on [[Dorumaa]], during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their members were all [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and they would occasionaly work as spotters for the [[Dorumaa Research Institute]]. [[Danel]] and [[Ko-oda]] were both members of it.
